insights.summary: From the H1 FY27 presentation (no call held): revenue rose 25% to ₹174.8 Cr and PAT 72% to ₹31.1 Cr, with EBITDA margin up to 25.1% from 19.0% as traded volumes were cut and premium products rose to 13.5% of sales. Exports were 72% of revenue. Receivable days halved to 47 as the large multinational customer's credit terms normalised, lifting operating cash flow to ₹78 Cr. Unit III Phase 1 is still in trial runs awaiting approvals, four months after the date given in May; Phase 2 is now targeted for H1 FY28.

red_flags.text: Unit III Phase 1 delayed again, with no new date; revenue depends on customer approvals that take years.

No call held for H1 FY27 despite investor requests in May.
